title: "Scraping Engine"

The main scraping workflow of PageSieve is controlled by an XState finite state machine implemented
in `packages/core/src/scrapeMachine.ts`. Below is a diagram of the states and transitions of
the state machine created with [Lini][1]. View [Lini source][2].
